current_evidence: Not verified: the WebFetch budget was used up before the Thanet planning page or PDFs could be read. A site-restricted search of thanet.gov.uk for 'validation checklist' returned only the 2018/03-uploaded type-specific checklists (003 Full and Outline, 011 Listed Building Consent) and the 'Planning permission' info page, with no newer local list.

issues.detail: The Full planning row shows '(none)', but the main source document is the 'Full and Outline Planning Permission Validation Checklist'. All 17 requirements taken from it were placed under Outline only, so Full planning applications show no local requirements at all.
issues.evidence: Full planning row: 'No specific local requirements identified...' with source 003-Full-and-Outline-Planning-Permission-Validation-Checklist.pdf

issues.detail: The 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' row has the Noise Impact Assessment trigger as its trigger. Its own trigger (isolated rural worker dwelling in the countryside) appears in the 'Viability Assessment' row instead.
issues.evidence: 'Noise Impact Assessment When required? For industrial uses falling within class B2 (general industrial uses) and that are proposed within 10 metres of a boundary with residential property and waste management facilities.'

issues.detail: The 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' row has no waste-storage trigger. Its excerpt is the end of the Transport Assessment trigger plus the Functional and viability Assessment. The word 'waste' only comes from 'waste management facilities' in the TA and noise thresholds, so this requirement appears to be invented.
issues.evidence: 'more; and waste management facilities What information is Transport implications of the proposal, including access to the site...'

issues.detail: The 'Viability Assessment' row is actually the 'Functional and viability Assessment' for isolated agricultural, equestrian or rural-enterprise dwellings, not a financial viability assessment. It is mislabelled and duplicates the rural worker dwelling requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Functional and viability Assessment When required? When the proposal includes an isolated dwelling in the countryside for agricultural; equestrian or other rural based enterprises business'

issues.detail: The Foul and Surface Water Assessment appears in the source text Grokbot extracted but has no row of its own. It is required for all major development, except changes of use with no material change in foul or surface water discharges.
issues.evidence: 'Foul and Surface Water Assessment When required? For all major development other than changes of use where there will be no material change in foul or surface water discharges'

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment trigger never says when an FRA is required. The excerpt starts mid-section and runs into the Foul and Surface Water and Contaminated Land headings.
issues.evidence: 'information is Flood Risk Assessment required? Detailed Guidance from the Environment Agency can be found at: Foul and Surface Water Assessment When required?...'

issues.detail: The Transport Assessment trigger is cut off after the first threshold. 'Residential development of 100 dwellings;' loses 'or more' and the other thresholds, such as floorspace and waste management facilities, which surface in the Waste row's excerpt.
issues.evidence: 'Transport Assessment When required? Residential development of 100 dwellings;'

issues.detail: The Street scene elevations row has an empty trigger. The excerpt shows a blank 'When required?' followed by the roof plan text.
issues.evidence: 'and Proposed Street Scene – Scale 1:100 When required? What information is required? Existing and Proposed Roof Plans...'

issues.detail: Items from the combined 'Householder and Listed Building Consent' checklist that apply only to listed buildings were copied to Householder. Examples: Structural survey for substantial or complete demolition of a listed building, and the Heritage Statement 'All Applications ... listing details of property'. The Design and Access Statement marked 'All Applications' is also under Householder. National rules only require a DAS for householder works in conservation areas or World Heritage Sites, so this needs checking against the source.
issues.evidence: Householder row Structural Survey: 'When the proposal involves substantial or complete demolition of a listed building.'

issues.detail: List date 2018-03-01 comes from the WordPress upload folder, not from document text. The same 2018/03 folder holds unrelated documents such as the HMO form and the contaminated land guide, which suggests a site migration date. The checklists' real adoption date is unknown and may be earlier.

Only 3 of Thanet's numbered type-specific checklists were read (002, 003 and 011). The numbering implies a series covering other application types. Advertisement consent, Lawful development certificate, prior approval, s73, discharge of conditions, works to trees and others are all recorded as '(none)' without their checklists being read.
A tab item is a recommendation joined to a heading fragment, not a requirement. The council tab also holds only 4 drawing-standard lines and none of the actual requirements.
issues.evidence: 'We would recommend a maximum print size of any document or drawing not to exceed A1 size. Application Form When required?'

issues.detail: The Householder and LBC Parking plan and Site sections triggers run on into the next items (Structural survey, Heritage Statement), so each row carries extra requirements.
issues.evidence: '...Drawing showing proposed parking arrangements. required? Structural survey When required? When the proposal involves substantial or complete demolition of a listed building. Heritage Statement When required?'

summary: The live source could not be fetched because the shared WebFetch budget was used up. A site-restricted search found no checklist newer than Grokbot's 2018/03-uploaded set, but whether it is current was not confirmed. Grokbot's own data has serious mapping errors: Full planning shows no requirements even though the source is the Full and Outline checklist, several triggers are swapped (Noise trigger on rural dwellings, Transport text on a made-up 'Waste' row), and Foul and Surface Water was missed.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
